title: Energy-minimizing measures supported near fractal 1-sets
summary: Energy techniques can be used to study the structure of fractal sets; the existence of a measure with finite Riesz energy supported on a set gives information about its dimension, distribution, and density. In this paper, we study energy-minimizing measures supported near fractal $1$-sets. Using physical analogy and a variant of the fast multipole method, we show a strong equidistribution result for these measures.
